paragraphs: Rav Tavla. Bava Batra 111a: R. Tavla acted in accordance with R. Zekharyah ben HaKatzav. Rav Nachman asked, “What is this?” He replied, “R. Chanina bar Shelamya said in Rav's name that the law follows R. Zekharyah ben HaKatzav.” He said, “Go retract, or I will remove Rav Chanina bar Shelamya from your ear.” Rashbam explains: “I will remove” means I will place you under a ban, and R. Chanina bar Shelamya will not assist you. Rashi, Sanhedrin, chapter 1, explains likewise; see Rav Kahana. Chullin 132b: R. Tavla's host was a priest in straitened circumstances. R. Tavla told him, “Enter a partnership with an Israelite butcher. Since you are exempt from the priestly gifts, they will enter partnership with you.” Rav Nachman held the Israelite partner liable. He said, “But R. Tavla exempted us!” He replied, “Go pay, or I will remove R. Tavla from your ear.” R. Tavla went before Rav Nachman and asked why he acted thus. He replied, “When R. Acha bar Chanina came from the South, he said in R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name: the elders of the South said a priest butcher is exempt from the gifts for two or three weeks, but afterward liable.” He said, “Let the Master at least act like R. Acha bar Chanina.” He answered, “That applies where he has not established a slaughterhouse; here he has established one.” Rashi explains “I will remove from your ear”: I will erase all his proofs and supports from your ear. Eruvin 75a, beginning: R. Yosef said, “I heard R. Tavla saying.” Menachot 78a: Rav Nachman son of Rav Chisda expounded in his name. Eruvin 12a, 16b, 48a, 86b: R. Tavla asked Rav. Shabbat 101a has “he asked Ravin,” a scribal error for Rav, since it is all the same matter. Rav Tavla said: Rav said—Bava Metzia, end of HaSokher Et HaPoalim; Jerusalem Talmud, Keitzad Mishtattefin. Chanin bar Abba, in Rav's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Bameh Ishah; Yevamot, chapter 12. R. Avina, in Rav's name: Sanhedrin, chapter 3, halakhah 8. R. Tanchum said: R. Tavla said: Rav Beruna said: Rav said—Sanhedrin 28b. Rav Yehudah, in his name.
